title: Cabuya publisher manifest (v0.1)

name.description: The protocol name: cabuya (decided 2026-08-16; domains cabuya.org + cabuyaprotocol.org).

publisher_id.description: Registry-assigned, human-readable, assigned once, never reassigned (R12).

canonical_url.description: Registry key is canonical URL + aliases, never a slug.

contact.description: Org-level contact only (role address). MUST NOT be a personal address.

entity.description: v0.1: place only. Person-level entities MUST NOT appear (§7.1).

municipality_code.description: DIVIPOLA, when the feed is a municipality shard.

tools_language.description: BCP 47 tag of tool identifiers (registry must not assume English).

license.description: SPDX identifier for the published data. REQUIRED — 1/20 apps declares one today and its absence blocks every consumer's legal review.

permitted_use.description: Consent-to-reuse in the envelope, not in robots.txt dialects.

events.description: Registry event ids served, e.g. sismos-co-2026. Event-scoped registry, event-optional records (Q10).

languages.description: BCP 47. es is the required ecosystem baseline.

$comment: Unknown members MUST be preserved by consumers and MUST NOT cause validation failure (verdict H). x_{publisher}_{field} namespaced extensions always allowed.
